$comment: Meal planner settings + data. 'weekStart' is the day the week view begins on ('sunday'…'saturday'). 'groceryList' is the Google Tasks list name grocery commits target (matched case-insensitively by the to-do module; falls back to its default list). 'meals' (the saved-meal library) and 'days' (YYYY-MM-DD → ordered meal-id list) are managed from the panel and persist as DB overrides, so this file stays empty.
